title: ALM First Client Investment Policy
description: Canonical shape for one client's extracted investment policy. Derived from the CSP preferred-language doc.

client.description: Client display name as it appears in S:\Clients\<ClientName>

policy_file.description: Original filename of the source policy doc

policy_file_hash.description: sha256 of the source file at extraction time

policy_date.description: Effective date of the policy if stated in the doc (ISO 8601)

policy_year_folder.description: Year folder under policies/ this came from

extraction_confidence.description: Self-reported model confidence the policy was mapped cleanly

portfolio_level_limits.description: Limits that apply across the whole portfolio rather than a single asset class

classification_rules.description: HTM vs AFS vs Trading defaults the policy states

unmapped_clauses.description: Verbatim clauses the extractor could not confidently map to the canonical schema. Always reviewed by a human before publish.

category.description: Canonical asset class name. See enum below for the master list; the extractor may add subtypes.

max_portfolio_pct.description: Cap as % of total investment portfolio

max_net_worth_pct.description: Cap as % of institutional net worth

single_issuer_pct.description: Cap on a single issuer, % of net worth

single_security_limit.description: Either a percentage ('10% of Net Worth') or a dollar amount ('$250,000')

verbatim_source.description: Original clause(s) from the policy doc that produced these fields. For human audit.
